description: Fast real-image segmentation probes for model-candidate sweeps. Each case pins the coverage band and component budget that past regressions violated. Paths are relative to the repo root unless absolute.

cases.name: tampa-grayline
cases.watches: Tesla dark-mode grayline: bottom vignette fringes inflate coverage past 0.35 when broken

cases.name: orlando-grayline
cases.watches: Tesla dark-mode grayline: under-fill drops below 0.30 when the gray fill is not recognized

cases.name: miami-light-fill
cases.watches: Translucent light fill: grayline-heavy fine-tunes punch holes in it (0.24 with holes when broken)

cases.name: satellite-regional
cases.watches: Satellite multi-zone: grabbing the orange/red district zones doubles coverage (0.31+ when broken)

cases.name: tampa-color-png
